visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit Japanese drugstore aisle, showing shelves filled with various cosmetics. A large pink and white text overlay introduces new Japanese pharmacy products for August 2025. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of a SANA NEW BORN display. A person's hand holds a white liquid eyebrow pen and draws extremely fine, hair-like strokes on the back of their other hand to demonstrate precision. (3) A hand picks up a bottle of Quality 1st VC Mist from a shelf. The bottle is amber-colored with a silver cap. (4) The focus shifts to a display of pink boxes for an at-home eyelash perm kit by Toa Sangyo. A hand picks up a box and turns it over to show the product specifications on the back. (5) A hand selects a small white bottle of FIANCEE hair styling gel from a shelf, showing the packaging details. (6) The final phase shows Yunth VC Tone Up UV cream. A hand squeezes a dollop of peach-colored cream onto the back of another hand and blends it in, showing the brightened skin effect under bright retail lighting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 2025年8月號 日本藥妝近期新品. (2) [Slogan]: SANA NEW BORN 超細液態眉筆. [Subtitle]: 這款真的超級細 只有0.01mm. (3) [Subtitle]: 可以輕鬆畫出自然的毛流感. (4) [Subtitle]: 一共有三種顏色 可以依照自己髮色挑選. (5) [Slogan]: Quality 1st VC 噴霧. [Subtitle]: 他們把高濃度維他命VC做成噴霧狀的啦. (6) [Subtitle]: 外出也能隨時補充 據說還可以防脫妝. (7) [Slogan]: 東亞產業 居家享用燙睫毛組. [Subtitle]: 沒想到竟然有在賣這個!!! (8) [Subtitle]: 操作時間只要30分鐘 效果大概可以維持1~2個月. (9) [Subtitle]: 一盒可以用5次 感覺還蠻划算的. (10) [Slogan]: FIANCÉE 瀏海整理凝膠. [Subtitle]: 有點類似乾洗髮 只是他是凝膠狀的. (11) [Subtitle]: 香味蠻好聞的 很適合夏天唷. (12) [Slogan]: Yunth 生VC光感妝前防曬乳. [Subtitle]: 這款最近很熱門 許多藥妝店都賣到缺貨. (13) [Subtitle]: 主打生VC成分 是防曬也是保養品. (14) [Subtitle]: 擦在臉上很乾爽 也不會覺得緊繃喔. (15) [Subtitle]: 我自己非常喜歡! 分享給你們.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase of new Japanese drugstore beauty and personal care products for August 2025. By demonstrating product usage and highlighting specific technical features (e.g., 0.01mm precision, high-concentration vitamin C) alongside vibrant retail visuals, it aims to inform and entice potential shoppers interested in J-beauty trends.
